g.text: Thin lines and points: individual protocol seeds. Thick lines: mean at each actual count.
Error bars: sample SD (ddof=1), not CI; at most 3 seeds per point. Reached-cap aliases counted once.
OLD64 uses the historical generator; only B-curve points share the fixed trajectory constraints.
